title: Every vegan, cruelty-free red or berry shade within a price cap
prompt: I only buy makeup that is both vegan and cruelty-free. I'm looking for red or berry shades of lip color or blush, and I won't pay more than $20 for any single item. Can you list every shade I can order today?
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every shade that meets all of my conditions. If nothing matches, return an empty list.
why_hard: The valid set is long (9 shades across 6 products and 2 categories), so completeness matters. The price cap is inclusive and depends on the promotion: two Aurevia shades pay exactly $20.00 after the discount (valid), one pays $20.80 (invalid), a new Aurevia launch gets no discount, and an excluded Aurevia blush is valid at full price. Several vegan shades are not cruelty-free.
traps: LIP-002-05 and LIP-015-01: list $25.00, pay exactly $20.00 after the promotion (valid; the cap is inclusive)
LIP-016-01 and LIP-016-02: Aurevia new launch at $24.00, no discount (invalid)
BLS-009-02 and BLS-009-04: Aurevia but excluded from the promotion, valid anyway at $18.00
LIP-011, LIP-006, BLS-008: vegan but not cruelty-free
LIP-018-01: vegan, cruelty-free and $19.00, but sold out
